name: Haiku quality compounders
strategy: Tactical sector rotation with small-cap momentum leverage, carry positioning in energy/financials, crypto capitulation accumulation, hedged mega-cap tech shorts; position-level stops + 28% dry powder.
novelty: Unlike prior AI/quality-focused rounds, this strategy harvests tactical cycles: long small-cap momentum (TNA) plus cyclical carry (XLF/XLE) plus depressed crypto lows, hedged by short mega-cap tech pairs (QQQ/SMH). Edge is valuation mean reversion and regime rotation (small-cap breakout, financial tightening stabilization, crypto recovery off capitulation lows) via leverage, systematic shorts, and weekly rebalancing—not moat-based quality accumulation.

positions.thesis: Small-cap 3x leverage on momentum continuation; TNA +106% YTD reflects sustained alpha in under-5B cap segment with compounding potential through Dec-31.
Energy carry on geopolitical uncertainty, OPEC supply coordination, and structural underinvestment; sector yields 2-3% and trades 0.8x book, inflation hedge as macro stabilizes.
Financial carry on stable US rates and strong net interest margins through 2026; dividend yield 2.5% with capital appreciation as credit stabilization unfolds.
Spot accumulation at -46% capitulation low; historical 6-12mo recovery post-drawdown averages 3-5x, institutional adoption (spot ETF inflows) provides downside support.
Quality factor (high ROE/margins) diversification versus cyclical longs; captures AI-driven software tail (MSFT, CRM, ADBE) without mega-cap concentration risk.
Defensive ballast with 1.5% yield; sector pricing margin headwinds (GLP-1 adoption), provides counter-cyclical hedge if growth falters unexpectedly.
Mega-cap tech hedge on compressed valuations post-AI hype; pair trade with small-cap/sector rotation, reprices lower if growth falters or rates rise.
Semiconductor sector at +103% YTD signals extreme positioning; hedges concentration risk in leveraged small-cap, reprices sharply on execution slowdown.

outlook: Macro environment supportive for carry trades (stable rates, no recession priced in). Small-cap momentum likely continues on M&A activity and equal-weight rotation. Crypto recovery is speculative but warranted at -40% drawdown. Primary risks: Fed surprises with rate cuts (hurts carry), geopolitical escalation (equity drawdown), mega-cap tech stabilization (stops QQQ short from working). Position-level stops at daily close plus weekly rebalancing provide tactical flexibility. Target NAV growth 8-12% through Dec-31; 28% cash provides dry powder for adds if volatility spikes.
